scores.scale: 0 = unusable; 5 = playable with substantial recurring friction; 7 = good with noticeable friction; 9 = excellent with only minor friction; 10 = exceptional. Scores assess only observed portrait emulation, independent of wins/losses; overall is holistic, not a computed mean.

reasons.overall_mobile: A complete mission is accessible through clear touch targets, tap aim and strong route/recover assistance. Manual orientation, changing contextual control roles, brief phase windows and small secondary labels add noticeable friction. Both wins establish completion, not sustained enjoyment or physical-phone quality.
reasons.controls: Two-contact move/fire responded, tap aim centered guard/coils, reload and scene swipes worked. Scene turn magnitude initially caused a wrong turn; route endpoint did not face coils. AIM, FIRE drag correction, dash, jump and tools not tested.
reasons.gameplay: Visible sequence offered recovery, patrol damage, shield resource pressure, armored/exposed coil timing and upload. Learned bursts reduced waste. Heavy route assistance and stationary coil targeting carried both missions, so depth, long-term interest and continuous enjoyment remain unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Coherent cyan/amber industrial atmosphere, stylized architecture and distinct terminal result layout. Dark geometry and roof/pillar views sometimes obscured intended target orientation. Audio and hardware rendering not assessed.
reasons.usability: Readable handbook, pausing map with selected route and distance, contextual recover progress and SAVED release cue, objective changes and numbered coil OFF feedback helped complete the mission. Long route holds could cross recovery transitions, making narrative moments easy to miss.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, major objective and coil state strip remained legible at 390x844. Fine uppercase labels, map legend and result detail text were noticeably small; dark scene reduced target discovery. No observed terminal-layout overflow.
